data.title: What hosts ask us.
items: Can I ask guests questions before they come?
Yes. Add your questions to the event, and the answers are on each guest’s record.
What happens when someone drops out?
Refunds follow your cancellation policy, and the seat is offered to the next person on the waitlist.
Can regulars book before everyone else?
Yes, with a membership: members can book early, pay a member price or have workshops included.
Can I sell a ticket that includes materials?
Yes. Set the price and say what’s included on the page.
No. They book, pay and check in in their phone’s browser.
Can I bring my list from Instagram DMs or a sheet?
Yes. Import a CSV or Excel file, or send it to us on WhatsApp and we’ll do it.
